Buybacks made up most of the $182M returned to shareholders; the release says total returns were up 78% versus the 12 months to 31 December 2025.

Investment commitments indicate capital is also being directed toward the portfolio; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Realisation proceeds support investment and capital returns, but only $195M had been received by 30 September.

This is a continuation of NBPE's stated capital-allocation approach, combining portfolio investment with shareholder returns, rather than a new buyback program already approved. The next catalyst is the 1 December 2026 EGM vote on renewed authority and subsequent disclosure of repurchases under it.
